values.note: Open only for the Arbuckle and Walk in Water WMA scouting and hunting dates, September through April ('RV/Tent camping at 7 campsites during hunting season only').

season.source: https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Lake-Wales-Ridge-State-Forest ('Livingston Creek Campground has seven primitive campsites and is open September through April'; 'Seven campsites (reservable during scouting and hunting dates on Arbuckle and Walk in Water WMAs from September through April)') + ReserveAmerica park page ('RV/Tent camping at 7 campsites during hunting season only'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Lake-Wales-Ridge-State-Forest ('Drinking water is available at the well house located at Livingston Creek Campground') + ReserveAmerica park page ('Potable water is accessible'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Class B or Class C only, up to 32 ft; no Class A. Pads 12 ft wide by 60 ft long, improved gravel, back-in. Up to 8 people and 2 vehicles per site.

sites.source: ReserveAmerica park page parkId 1120404 ('RV/Camper trailer size limit - Class B or Class C only, maximum of 32 ft length', 'Pads are 12 ft wide by 60 ft long', 'No Class A RV/Campers permitted') + campsiteDetails.do ('Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Gravel, Improved', 'Max Num of People: 8'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All Sites require advanced reservation for camping on site.' Reservations can be made for the same day and up to 11 months ahead.

booking.source: ReserveAmerica park page parkId 1120404 ('All Sites require advanced reservation for camping on site'; Booking Window 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florida Forest Service hunt-camp-style campground on the Arbuckle tract of Lake Wales Ridge State Forest, each site with picnic table and fire ring. Drive-in via paved Rucks Dairy Rd. Bears and raccoons frequent the area; store food. --Claude
